themes.title: Crypto rises with stocks
themes.summary: Bitcoin rose about 1% to near $74,500 as the Nasdaq gained 1.6% on a chip and AI rally led by CoreWeave (Yahoo Finance).

themes.title: Deutsche Bank launches crypto custody
themes.summary: Deutsche Bank opened a MiCA-regulated custody service for Bitcoin, Ether, USDC, EURC and EURAU for institutional clients across Europe; retail customers are excluded (Bitcoin.com News).

themes.title: ETF outflows slow
themes.summary: U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs lost about $95 million on Tuesday, a fourth straight day of outflows but smaller than prior days (CoinDesk), after $201 million left on Monday (KuCoin).

themes.title: Rate-hike expectations weigh
themes.summary: Hotter-than-expected October CPI (up 0.4% month over month) has lifted rate-hike expectations and Treasury yields, which tends to pressure risk assets (KuCoin).

themes.title: Sentiment stays fearful
themes.summary: CoinGecko's Fear & Greed gauge reads 'Fear' at 35, up from a reading of 29 reported early Wednesday (KuCoin).

watch_list.why: Another inflation reading after the hot October CPI, ahead of the Fed's December meeting where a hike is widely expected (KuCoin).
Analysts cite that zone as support, with $74,500–$75,000 as the level to reclaim for a recovery (KuCoin).
Spot ETF outflows have slowed; a return to inflows, along with uptake of new bank custody services like Deutsche Bank's, would signal buyers returning.
